exposure: Immediate postpartum IUD placement (within 10 minutes of placental delivery)
outcome: Obstetrician-gynecologist or women's health office visits within 1 year
Formal imaging studies related to IUD complications within 1 year
Surgical intervention related to IUD complications within 1 year
Hospitalizations related to IUD complications within 1 year
Live births at 120 days and 1 year
cohort: The study included 1,543 patients with immediate IUD placement and 10,332 patients with delayed IUD placement (between 0 and 63 days postpartum) from Kaiser Permanente Northern California between 2017 and 2019.
finding: Immediate postpartum IUD placement, compared to delayed placement, is not associated with increased office visits, but is linked to an increase in imaging and a decrease in laparoscopic surgery for IUD-related complications, with no significant difference in live birth rates.
